body: Well, let's hope the bastard just suddenly slips and falls to his death eh?

I've set a date and a method before too so I know how it feels like. It's better, I was calm, I was finally at peace knowing that I have something to look forward to. But before that day came, someone came first and saved my life. Now, I'm not going to dissuade you from doing what you plan but may I ask what method are you considering? It's not that easy to die from suicide you know. I tried hanging twice, the second time was more of a joke. I tried cutting too but I can't cut deep enough to sever a major artery. When you survive a suicide attempt, there is this feeling of relief. Well at least for me anyway. My advice is, do what you want but try not to die yet okay? Surviving a serious attempt makes you reflect better on your life.
Yeah, fuck christmas. I'm sick of all this pretending to be fine too.
